false_positives_notes: Inspected implementations all fail closed: noble-hashes Ui()/Ln()/rh()/utils.randomBytes and noble-curves randomPrivateKey call crypto.getRandomValues (or node crypto.randomBytes) and throw if missing; CryptoJS 4.x WordArray.random uses getRandomValues/randomBytes via cryptoSecureRandomInt and throws 'Native crypto module could not be used'; brorand _rand uses self.crypto.getRandomValues or throws 'Not implemented yet'; uuid v4 binds getRandomValues/randomUUID or throws. generateMnemonic() in options/welcome/prompt is an RPC; background runs tl(fl,128) = @scure/bip39 encode of Ui(16) CSPRNG bytes. Nostr generatePrivateKey derives via BIP32 m/44'/1237'/0'/0/0 from the encrypted master mnemonic, not a fresh weak RNG. Bitcoin taproot keys are HD-derived from that mnemonic (m/86'/…); Liquid SLIP-77 blinding is from the seed. AES-CBC / NIP-04 IVs use Ui(16) or WordArray.random(16); vault generateSalt uses globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(32); CryptoJS password-based AES salt uses WordArray.random(8). The background crypto={getRandomValues} snippet is a Go/WASM Node polyfill via randomFillSync, not a Math.random mock; browsers already have Web Crypto and otherwise throw. BitSet.js v5.1.1 defines BitSet.Random via Math.random but has zero call sites. ECPair.makeRandom is unused (only fromPrivateKey). html5-qrcode Alea/Mash (4022871197) is scanner palette only. Remaining Math.random uses are React/confetti/react-router keys, inpage/content-script postMessage ids, JWT/native request ids, and Dexie localStorage sync triggers — not keys/mnemonics/IVs/nonces/seeds. Date.now is used for timestamps/TTL/created_at, not entropy. No seedrandom, Mersenne, LCG, or Date.now entropy seeds.
summary: Alby 3.2.1 的助记词、私钥与 AES-CBC/NIP-04 IV 均通过 crypto.getRandomValues 生成，缺失 CSPRNG 时直接抛错，不回退到 Math.random。助记词由后台 @scure/bip39（tl(fl,128)）用 noble-hashes Ui(16) 取 16 字节熵；Nostr/Bitcoin/Liquid 私钥从加密主助记词 HD 派生；账户盐、签名辅助随机数与 uuid 同样只接受原生 CSPRNG。BitSet.Random 使用 Math.random 但无调用点；其余 Math.random 与 Alea 仅用于 React/路由、请求关联 ID、彩带动画和扫码配色。未发现用于密钥、助记词、IV/nonce 或种子的弱随机数缺陷。
